events.name: New Jersey Devils at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Ryan Leonard scored a highlight-reel goal and the Washington Capitals beat the New Jersey Devils 4-2 on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Leonard scores highlight-reel goal, leads the Capitals over the Devils 4-2

headlines.description: — Nikolaj Ehlers scored a power-play goal 6:43 into the third period to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their seventh straight victory, 3-2 over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ehlers’ power-play winner lifts Hurricanes past Jets 3-2 for 7th straight win

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored twice, Jake Guentzel had a goal and an assist, and Dennis Hildeby stopped 12 shots as the Tampa Bay Lightning defeated the Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning storm back from 2-goal deficit to beat the Canucks 4-2

headlines.description: — Carter Verhaeghe had a history-making natural hat trick, Sam Bennett scored his first three goals of the season and the Florida Panthers rolled past the Seattle Kraken 8-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Verhaeghe, Bennett each get hat tricks, Panthers roll past Kraken 8-3

events.name: New York Islanders at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat scored the winner and added an assist to help the New York Islanders beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Horvat scores winner and adds assist in Islanders' 4-1 win over Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime to lift the Montreal Canadiens over the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores his second goal in OT to lift Canadiens over Sabres 4-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Lucas Raymond scored the only goal during the shootout and the Detroit Red Wings rallied for a 4-3 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lucas Raymond scores in shootout as Red Wings rally for 4-3 win over Sharks

headlines.description: — Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each had a goal and an assist, and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Ottawa Senators 3-1 on Saturday night for their first victory this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michkov and Martone lead Flyers past Senators 3-1 for 1st win of season after 9-game skid

events.name: New York Rangers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kent Johnson scored with 1:33 remaining on the clock in overtime, Jet Greaves got his fifth career shutout and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New York Rangers 1-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kent Johnson scores in OT as Blue Jackets beat Rangers 1-0 behind Jet Greaves' shutout

headlines.description: — Jake Oettinger made 19 saves for his NHL-leading third shutout in six games, Arttu Hyry scored twice and the Dallas Stars beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oettinger has 3rd shutout of season, Hyry scores twice in Stars' 4-0 win over Blackhawks

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Filip Forsberg scored a goal and added an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 5-2 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg scores first of the season as the Predators beat the Blues 5-2

events.name: Boston Bruins at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Marat Khusnutdinov scored in the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Los Angeles Kings 4-1 on Saturday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins beat the Kings 4-1 for their 5th straight victory

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had two goals and three assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Utah Mammoth 6-2 on Saturday night to split a home-and-home series.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid has 2 goals and 3 assists in the Oilers' 6-2 romp over the Mammoth

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mark Stone had a goal and two assists, and the Vegas Golden Knights extended their strong start by romping past the slumping Pittsburgh Penguins 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights rout Penguins 6-2 as Mark Stone nets a goal and 2 assists
